mentions.claim_text: He reads headlines about black market petrol stations reopening in Russia, a second day of fuel crisis in Dagestan forcing drivers to park, and questions about how children will get to school from 1 September.
mentions.quote: Black market gas station have begun to open again in Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: the news items are read from the screen, not claimed as his word.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail as stated; the reporting is the source, not a forecast.
